chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The one in ihram must not take from the hair of the one who is not in ihram.

key_terms.الْحَرَامُ: the person in the state of ihram
key_terms.الْحَلَالِ: the person who is not in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a person in ihram cut the hair of someone who is not in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to the restrictions of ihram during hajj or 'umrah. It states that a muhrim is not permitted to cut or take hair from a person who is not in the state of ihram.
